تزدرعوا (form VIII)
# تَزْدَرِعُوا (tazdariʕū) /taz.da.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# تُزْدَرَعُوا (tuzdaraʕū) /tuz.da.ra.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
